heading: Program authorized

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Secretary may carry out a charter school program that supports charter schools that serve early childhood, elementary school, or secondary school students by—

children.text: supporting the startup of new charter schools, the replication of high-quality charter schools, and the expansion of high-quality charter schools;
assisting charter schools in accessing credit to acquire and renovate facilities for school use; and
carrying out national activities to support—
the dissemination of best practices of charter schools for all schools;
the evaluation of the impact of the charter school program under this part on schools participating in such program; and

tree.heading: Funding allotment
tree.text: From the amount made available under section 7221j of this title for a fiscal year, the Secretary shall—

children.text: reserve 12.5 percent to support charter school facilities assistance under section 7221c of this title;
reserve 22.5 percent to carry out national activities under section 7221d of this title; and
use the remaining amount after the reservations under paragraphs (1) and (2) to carry out section 7221b of this title.

tree.heading: Prior grants and subgrants
tree.text: The recipient of a grant or subgrant under part B of title V (as such part was in effect on the day before December 10, 2015) shall continue to receive funds in accordance with the terms and conditions of such grant or subgrant.

notes.text: References in TextPart B of title V (as such part was in effect on the day before December 10, 2015), referred to in subsec. (c), means part B of title V of Pub. L. 89–10, which was classified generally to part B (§ 7221 et seq.) of subchapter V of this chapter prior to being amended by Pub. L. 114–95. Pub.
